explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 122 to 81 lines (33.6%) and from 9,569 to 6,287 characters (34.3%). Six connected peripherals expand intake, capture/mutation, evidence, review, acceptance and storage. [M] denotes modular boundaries and dependencies, [C] calls, [O] ownership and lifetime, and [D] computational data dependencies. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps; edges reference meaningful nodes using 1-based lines.

Corrections: ChangeSessionService.validateReady validates a DiffTree only if present; complete_diff_session separately checks full captured-hunk coverage. The supplied acceptance code passes expectedRevisionId and receives a catalog receipt, but the catalog implementation is absent, so atomic publication and persisted-revision enforcement cannot be verified. ChangeSessionRecords embeds the summary in its manifest rather than referencing a separate summary record. Acceptance compares live document content and name, not capturedVersion.

Additional source-grounded details include connection identity restrictions and pinned Git graph traversal (pushIntegrationService.ts, gitPushSource.ts); diff options and limits (repositoryHunks.ts); capture signatures, receipt namespaces and annotation restrictions (changeSessionService.ts); stage-specific patch defaults (diffSessionTools.ts); default-tree size fallback and mapping replacement (diffTree.ts); exact migration resolution (diagramMigration.ts); worker revision registration, cache limits and conditional token checks (diagramChangeSessionStore.ts, changeSessionRecords.ts); and local preview layout, search identity checks and navigation boundaries (ChangeSessionPreview.tsx). Workflow lifetime follows diffSessionWorkflowService.ts; proposal/context validation follows diagramChangeSession.ts. All evidence comes from context.json and seed.json. Source-reader, preview-worker, catalog and publication-helper internals are not supplied; diagrams distinguish visible calls and contracts from unverified implementation details.
